lateral_torso_line_topology.vertical_line_count_and_spacing: 12 distinct vertical lines; spacing is relatively wide at the shoulder and becomes progressively denser and more regular across the mid-torso and posterior.
lateral_torso_line_topology.intersection_coordinates_bifurcations: A Y-shaped bifurcation is visible on the 10th line from the anterior, located on the upper haunch where the line splits into two ventral segments.
lateral_torso_line_topology.discontinuity_mapping: The first four anterior lines are truncated at the upper-mid torso, failing to reach the dorsal ridge. Several posterior lines terminate into spot clusters near the ventral line.

posterior_constellation_clusters.spatial_cluster_density: A high-density grouping of approximately 7 to 9 white spots is visible on the lateral aspect of the hindquarter, primarily concentrated above the hock.
posterior_constellation_clusters.linear_blob_alignment: Three distinct spots align horizontally across the lower thigh, creating a semi-connected geometric segment parallel to the ground.

other_distinctive_markers: White chevron marking between the eyes and two distinct white spots on the lower cheek/mandible area are clearly visible.
